title: A Bug's Life Hopper 1998 McDonald's Happy Meal Promo Card Disney Pixar
condition_description: Near mint or better. See photos.
description:
1998 McDonald's promotional card for Disney/Pixar's A Bug's Life - Hopper, "bugs kick grass!" Back has Hopper's character bio, "coming to theatres thanksgiving," and the McDonald's Happy Meal tie-in.

Ships in an eBay Standard Envelope.
